First, convert 48 weeks and 2 days into days:  
48 weeks × 7 days/week = 336 days  
336 days + 2 days = 338 days to subtract.

Start date: 1239-09-05 (assuming YYYY-MM-DD format).  
Subtract 338 days:  
1239 is not a leap year (divisible by 4 but not by 400, so not leap in Gregorian proleptic).  
From 1239-09-05 back 338 days:  
Go to 1239-01-01: 31+28+31+30+31+30+31+31 = 243 days from Jan 1 to Sep 5? Let's check:  
Jan 31, Feb 28, Mar 31, Apr 30, May 31, Jun 30, Jul 31, Aug 31 = 31+28+31+30+31+30+31+31 = 243 days. So Sep 5 is day 248 of the year (243 days before Sep 1, so Sep 5 = 243+5 = 248).  
248 − 338 = −90 days from start of 1239.  
So go into previous year 1238.  
1238 is not leap (not divisible by 4).  
365 − 90 = 275th day of 1238.  
275th day: Jan 31 (31), Feb 28 (59), Mar 31 (90), Apr 30 (120), May 31 (151), Jun 30 (181), Jul 31 (212), Aug 31 (243), Sep 30 (273).  
275 − 273 = 2 → Oct 2, 1238.

FINAL_ANSWER: 1238-10-02
